data.summary_en: Training-free Source-Judged Compaction (SJC) post-processing: non-generative judge model Jev per compaction checks whether summary items are sourced from environment outputs or prior summary, deleting unsourced items without changing agent/compressor; on AppWorld and OfficeBench, multi-run reliability improves 2.1%-8.9% over original compressor without extra agent tokens.
